_comment: Site-wide invariants. Values are identical in both languages; anything that differs per locale lives in ui.json.
shortName: Federation of Polish Student Societies UK
_academicYear: Deliberately NOT here. The current academic year is content, not site configuration, and lives in content/settings/academic-year.yaml as records.settings.academicYear.current. A Phase 2 placeholder sat here saying 2026/27 and was already contradicting the 2025/26 roster; two sources of truth for the same fact is exactly the bug this architecture exists to prevent.
_defaultOgImage: The shared Federation banner, 1200x630. Pages with their own photo override ogImage and omit the width/height fields.
